Little details.

A practical guide to starting a childcare conversation, without the guesswork.

✳
✷ Parent notebook

Let’s make the next step a little easier.

Choosing care should begin with the details that matter most to your family. Here are three helpful places to start.

✳
01

Check the fit

Compare the state-listed age ranges and school-year hours with your family's needs.

02

Ask about openings

Enrollment availability, tuition and start dates aren't listed in the state record; call or email to confirm them.

03

Plan the practical bits

Ask about meals, what to pack, drop-off, rest, communication and any paperwork before enrolling.

THE LITTLE LIST / KEEP THIS HANDY

Questions worth asking.

□

What openings are available for my child's age?

□

What are tuition, fees and payment policies?

□

What are drop-off and pickup arrangements?

□

How are meals, supplies and rest handled?

□

How does the school-year calendar work?

□

What documents are needed for enrollment?

A NOTE ON THE CALENDAR

School-year care.

Oklahoma Human Services lists this program as school year only, with Monday–Friday hours of 7:30 AM–4:00 PM. Contact the center to confirm specific dates, holidays and closure plans.
